<b>Lavalargas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They're the full-grown versions of [[Lavalug]]s, and can expel much more fluid as a result.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Lavalargas move back and forth along walls or ceilings, stopping and shooting out a jet of droplets of lava when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] moves near them that deals {{Damage|2|type=Fire}}. The jet of lava is shot straight out from the top of the Lavalarga, either vertically or horizontally, depending on which surface the Lavalarga is on, as well as in a smaller radius around it.

When killed, Lavalargas build up before exploding in lava, shooting out in a small radius in all directions.

It should be noted that Lavalargas respawn upon re-entering the room, despite their size.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Lavalargas have their health doubled. They gain one of the following [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]]: Void Blades or Void Projectiles.

== Location ==
Lavalargas can be found in the lowest part of the [[Deep Docks]], in the room leading up to the [[Diving Bell]].
